name: ultitech-erp-android
description: UltiTech ERP Android client (Capacitor shell for the hosted web app)

scripts.sync: npm run copy-config && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
